decisions: CSharp shared policy owns the exact environment result ABI, Windows globals and all Windows/Linux helper bodies. Both CSharp platform consumers preserve their original literal values and newline spacing. CSharp original84, parallel64 lookups, loop4 and helper24 pass before any SLG implementation edit.

Original Windows SLG helper/globals and Linux helper match the compiled CSharp source instruction lines after ignoring whitespace and the existing function attribute marker. Reuse generated NativeRuntime region methods, not text extraction during compiler execution or a copied helper schema.

Windows allocation tracking uses release/acquire cmpxchg and one-shot disposal; retain every validation, conversion, missing/empty/API error/allocation failure branch. Linux borrowed getenv result, embedded-NUL rejection, key free and Option flags remain unchanged. Platform declaration placement stays in the caller.
